Test Case Name: Case1 - Stage Transition with All Required Fields Populated
Description: Verify successful stage transition from Prospecting to Bid Creation when all eight mandatory fields are populated
Pre-conditions: Opportunity exists in Prospecting stage; User has Opportunity Owner/Bid Manager permissions
Step Description: Navigate to the Opportunity record in Prospecting stage
Expected Result: Opportunity record opens successfully

Step Description: Populate all eight fields: Nearshore/Offshore, (Expected) Contract Type, Bid Manager, Surveillance Director, Bid/No Bid Decision, Pre-Sales Risk Level, Expected Submission Date, Project Margin (%)
Expected Result: All fields accept values and are saved

Step Description: Change the Stage picklist value to Bid Creation
Expected Result: Stage transition is successful without validation errors

Step Description: Save the Opportunity record
Expected Result: Record saves successfully; Opportunity is now in Bid Creation stage

Expected Result: Opportunity record opens successfully

Expected Result: Fields are set as specified

Step Description: Change the Stage picklist value to Bid Creation and click Save
Expected Result: Validation error appears at Nearshore/Offshore field level: "To move to the "Bid Creation" stage or any subsequent stage, a value in this field is required."
